messages:
Alex: who's in for a dumb super-bowl-commercials pick'em? :tv:
Maya: im in. winner buys bagels Monday. :bagel:
Julian: count me. picking the Doritos spot, always banger.
Priya: meh i vote GOAT brand we all secretly hate. i'm taking the car ad (boring but wins awards)
Sam: can we do a bracket? best 3 ads wins?
Alex: yea 16-ad bracket. pick order => round of 16, quarters, semis, final. losers owe snack duty.
Adrian: i made a sheet //docs.google.com/super-bowl-ads-pool (pls DM if access issue)
Maya: @Adrian added emojis column please dont judge :joy:
Julian: quick rule: if an ad is literally a trailer (movie/game) it counts, but stunts only count if >1 celebrity
Priya: tie-breaker: most memes created within 24h after airing.
Sam: also bonus point if the ad makes the CTO laugh out loud (we will ask him) :eyes:
Alex: ok bots, create a 3-option poll for participation
poll-bot: POLL: "Super Bowl Ads Pick'em - Join?" Options: 1) I'm in (bracket) 2) I watch but pass 3) nope
Maya: 1
Julian: 1
Priya: 1
Sam: 1
Adrian: 1
Alex: rules recap: entry by kickoff, final picks locked at kickoff, edits allowed until 5 min before kickoff, bracket scoring: round of 16 x1, quarters x2, semis x4, final x8.
Maya: staple question: what's the buy-in? $5? $10?
Julian: $5 - low barrier, high pretzel energy.
Priya: $10 for bagels++ then. fine by me.
Sam: someone volunteer to scoreboard on Monday?
Adrian: I can tally, will post results in #random Tue morning.
Alex: @Maya you on snack procurement if i win? :pray:
Maya: absolutely. if i lose, i still buy bagels because clearly im cursed this year.
poll-bot: Poll results: 5 votes for "I'm in (bracket)", 0 for "I watch but pass", 0 for "nope". Poll closed.
Alex: nice. sending invites to sheet now. good luck y'all :trophy:
Priya: reminder - tag me if you post meme contenders in #memes channel, will archive top 10 for tie-break.
Julian: may the weirdest ad win.
Sam: also: if the Puppy ad wins i will cry.
Adrian: added a little column for "snack preference" so winners can choose.
Alex: done for now — signing off to practice my hot-take for halftime :sunglasses:
